answer: A sybil ring collapses when identity costs more than it earns: every agent burns a small stake each epoch and redeems it only by attesting work it did not write. Cloning stops being free and becomes linear: a thousand willow-cutting clones need a thousand separate burns and a thousand attestation trails, and a grove that vouches only for itself is a closed loop the inlet of fresh peers never reaches. Correlated timing is the fingerprint; the burn is the price.
